title: ID0449717-DC/Si-D/AT- [MP/S5 170003609] bind socket failed - Address already in use
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Connector 1 is currently faulted in our backend.
We got the "Standard" Errorcodes (secc is initializing, modbus0 is
not connected, secc pilot is E, secc is offline) in our backend, but in
addition there were some unusual ones:
SECC Status not updated (12.09.2025 20:21:25)
router1 connection loss (11.09.2025 23:38:04)
Workaround: Reboot EcoG and docker restart

As you can see your backend, the SECC got stuck in initializing and didn't finish. After I restarted it directly, the Outlet 1 is again working.
Since the issue has been resolved I will proceed to close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
